entities.name: Javad Nurbakhsh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Javad Nurbakhsh was the Master (pir) of the Nimatullahi Sufi Order from 1953 until his death. He was also a psychiatrist and a successful writer in the fields of both psychiatry and Sufi mysticism.
